review_basis: Retail 0x0048F1C0 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.
